senses.gloss: f. (v. טַב a. טַבְוָא) (in a) good manner, well, properly (h. .
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 9:21">Targ. Y. Deut. IX, 21</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ top <he>לא עבדין ט׳</he> do not do right.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:7">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>מאן דקרי ט׳ וכ׳</he> I will go to whosoever explains the Bible well etc.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:7:6">Y. Shebu. VII, 38ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אין אתא הא ט׳</he> if he appears, it is well.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:1:4">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> top <he>וטבות כן</he> Bab. ed. (Y. ed. <he>וטבא</he>) and so it is right. Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ top <he>וטבבו כן</he> (corr. acc.)—Hebr. form: <he>טָּבִית</he>.
<cite ref="Meilah 17a">Meïl. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ אמר</he> he spoke well (he is right).
